{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# Look for commas in the revenue column
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many rows have commas
num_with_commas = has_commas.sum()

# Show a sample of those rows
sample_with_commas = df.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head()

num_with_commas, sample_with_commas"}
